q: How much does ultrapure water add to an electronics plant's energy and emissions?
title: Ultrapure water: energy and CO2
short: It adds electricity for pumps, reverse osmosis, electrodeionisation, UV and recirculation, which run all day. Sub meter the water plant if you can; otherwise estimate from motor ratings and hours and label it. It is usually a few percent of a fab's power but grows with recirculation loops.
audience: Semiconductor, display and electronics plants in Penang, Kulim and India's semiconductor parks

ul: High pressure pumps for reverse osmosis.
Continuous recirculation to keep water pure.

p: Sub meters on the water plant feeders give kWh directly. Multiply by the grid factor, and divide by cubic metres produced for a per unit figure.
Variable speed pumps, higher water reclaim and right sized loops cut both water and kWh.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into a dated, fingerprinted record per plant; for sites outside India the grid factor is entered from the official source and labelled.
